 535:     private FreshReplayStats generateFreshSignals(
 536:             long runId,
 537:             String symbol,
 538:             Instant executionStart,
 539:             Instant executionEnd,
 540:             List<Candle> oneMinuteCandles,
 541:             List<Candle> fiveMinuteCandles,
 542:             List<Candle> oneHourCandles,
 543:             String btcSymbol,
 544:             List<Candle> btcOneMinuteCandles,
 545:             List<Candle> btcFiveMinuteCandles,
 546:             List<Candle> btcOneHourCandles,
 547:             ReplayDataSource dataSource,
 548:             ReplayDataset replayDataset
 549:     ) {
 550:         List<ReplayCandle> timeline = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
 551:         oneMinuteCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(symbol, "1m", c, true)));
 552:         fiveMinuteCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(symbol, "5m", c, true)));
 553:         oneHourCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(symbol, "1h", c, true)));
 554:         btcOneMinuteCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(btcSymbol, "1m", c, false)));
 555:         btcFiveMinuteCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(btcSymbol, "5m", c, false)));
 556:         btcOneHourCandles.forEach(c -> timeline.add(new ReplayCandle(btcSymbol, "1h", c, false)));
 557:         timeline.sort(java.util.Comparator
 558:                 .comparing((ReplayCandle rc) -> rc.candle().getOpenTime().plusSeconds(intervalSeconds(rc.interval())))
 559:                 .thenComparingInt(rc -> intervalOrder(rc.interval()))
 560:                 .thenComparingInt(rc -> rc.primary() ? 1 : 0));
 561: 
 562:         int oneMinuteSignals = 0, fiveMinuteSignals = 0, oneHourSignals = 0;
 563:         int oneMinuteBuys = 0, fiveMinuteBuys = 0, oneHourBuys = 0;
 564:         int buys = 0, watches = 0, sells = 0, strongSells = 0, errors = 0;
 565:         java.util.List<TradeSignal> generatedSignals = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
 566: 
 567:         // FIX-11L: Replay-only deep profiling for the Generate fresh signals stage.
 568:         // These monotonic timers observe existing calls only; they do not alter inputs,
 569:         // call ordering, persistence, thresholds, or any Production trading behavior.
 570:         ReplayFreshSignalProfiler profiler = new ReplayFreshSignalProfiler(runId, dataSource);
 571:         // FIX-11M: Enable aggregate timing only for this Replay worker thread.
 572:         // The shared AnalysisService decision path is unchanged; this is observation-only.
 573:         analysisService.beginReplayAnalysisProfiling(runId);
 574:         try (ExecutionReplayScope.Scope ignored = replayScope.open(runId, List.of(), o -> {})) {
 575:         // FIX-043 Replay parity: fresh Replay has always generated technical snapshots/signals
 576:         // chronologically for EVERY closed candle in the timeline. Production now restores the
 577:         // same no-gap contract with asynchronous close-event processing plus chronological recovery.
 578:         // Do not "optimize" Replay by sampling every Nth candle or by copying the production recovery
 579:         // scheduler cadence; that would recreate the exact 1m->~5m blind-gap incident FIX-043 fixes.
 580:         for (int index = 0; index < timeline.size(); index++) {
 581:             checkStopRequested(runId);
 582:             ReplayCandle replay = timeline.get(index);
 583:             Candle candle = replay.candle();
 584:             Instant evaluationTime = candle.getOpenTime().plusSeconds(intervalSeconds(replay.interval()));
 585:             boolean inRequestedWindow = !evaluationTime.isBefore(executionStart) && !evaluationTime.isAfter(executionEnd);
 586:             try {
 587:                 long operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
 588:                 java.util.Optional<IndicatorSnapshot> snapshot;
 589:                 try {
 590:                     snapshot = dataSource == ReplayDataSource.DATASET
 591:                             ? technicalIndicatorService.calculateSnapshotForRegression(
 592:                                     replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle.getOpenTime(), replayDataset)
 593:                             : technicalIndicatorService.calculateSnapshotForRegression(
 594:                                     replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle.getOpenTime());
 595:                 } finally {
 596:                     profiler.recordSnapshot(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
 597:                 }
 598:                 if (snapshot.isEmpty()) {
 599:                     if (inRequestedWindow) {
 600:                         errors++;
 601:                         saveGenerationError(runId, replay.symbol(), replay.interval(), candle,
 602:                                 "Not enough historical candles to calculate the technical snapshot");
 603:                     }
 604:                     continue;
 605:                 }
 606: 
 607:                 // Do not generate a signal whose candle would only have closed after the
 608:                 // requested test end. Warm-up rows before executionStart are intentionally
 609:                 // generated for as-of context, but are not counted or displayed as test output.
 610:                 if (evaluationTime.isAfter(executionEnd)) continue;
 611: 
 612:                 replayScope.reference(evaluationTime);
 613:                 operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();
 614:                 TradeSignal generated;
 615:                 try {
 616:                     generated = analysisService.analyzeForRegression(snapshot.get(), evaluationTime);
 617:                 } finally {
 618:                     profiler.recordAnalysis(System.nanoTime() - operationStartedNs);
 619:                 }
 620:                 replayScope.appendSignal(generated);
 621:                 SignalDecision decision = generated.getDecision();
 622:                 if (replay.primary()) generatedSignals.add(generated);
 623: 
 624:                 if (replay.primary() && inRequestedWindow) {
 625:                     if ("1m".equals(replay.interval())) { oneMinuteSignals++; if (isBuy(decision)) oneMinuteBuys++; }
 626:                     else if ("5m".equals(replay.interval())) { fiveMinuteSignals++; if (isBuy(decision)) fiveMinuteBuys++; }
 627:                     else if ("1h".equals(replay.interval())) { oneHourSignals++; if (isBuy(decision)) oneHourBuys++; }
 628: 
 629:                     if (decision == SignalDecision.BUY || decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY) buys++;

 632:                     else if (decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_SELL) strongSells++;
 633: 
 634:                     operationStartedNs = System.nanoTime();

 638:                                 (test_run_id, source_signal_id, replay_generated, symbol, interval_code, candle_open_time,

 648:                             generated.getOriginalDecision() == null ? null : generated.getOriginalDecision().name(),
 649:                             decision == null ? null : decision.name(),

 708:     @Transactional(readOnly = true)
 709:     public Map<String, Object> provenTradeChart(String symbol, String interval) {
 710:         String normalized = symbol == null ? "" : symbol.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
 711:         String normalizedInterval = switch (interval == null ? "5m" : interval.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
 712:             case "1m", "5m", "1h", "4h" -> interval.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
 713:             default -> "5m";
 714:         };
 715:         List<Map<String, Object>> trades = jdbcTemplate.queryForList("""
 716:                 SELECT id, source_test_run_id, source_trade_id, symbol, entry_time, entry_price, exit_time, exit_price,
 717:                        exit_reason, realized_pnl_usdt, realized_pnl_percent, position_percent, marked_at
 718:                 FROM proven_analyzed_trade
 719:                 WHERE symbol = ?
 720:                 ORDER BY entry_time ASC
 721:                 LIMIT 250
 722:                 """, normalized);
 723:         java.util.LinkedHashMap<String, Map<String, Object>> candles = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
 724:         for (Map<String, Object> trade : trades) {
 725:             Timestamp entry = (Timestamp) trade.get("entry_time");
 726:             Timestamp exit = (Timestamp) trade.get("exit_time");
 727:             if (entry == null) continue;
 728:             // Proven-analysis charts intentionally use real historical candles with a wide context window.
 729:             // Keep seven hours before the BUY and seven hours after the SELL so manual review can
 730:             // detect late entries and premature exits instead of judging only the replay window.
 731:             Instant from = entry.toInstant().minus(java.time.Duration.ofHours(7));
 732:             Instant to = (exit == null ? entry.toInstant() : exit.toInstant()).plus(java.time.Duration.ofHours(7));
 733:             List<Map<String, Object>> segment = candleReader(jdbcTemplate).queryForList("""
 734:                     SELECT open_time, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume
 735:                     FROM candle
 736:                     WHERE symbol=? AND interval_code=? AND closed=1 AND open_time BETWEEN ? AND ?
 737:                     ORDER BY open_time ASC
 738:                     """, normalized, normalizedInterval, Timestamp.from(from), Timestamp.from(to));
 739:             for (Map<String, Object> c : segment) candles.put(String.valueOf(c.get("open_time")), c);
 740:         }
 741:         return Map.of("symbol", normalized, "interval", normalizedInterval, "trades", trades,
 742:                 "candles", new java.util.ArrayList<>(candles.values()));
 743:     }

  25: /**
  26:  * FIX-11Q ƒ?" Replay-only one-candle continuation grace experiment.
  27:  *
  28:  * The Production-parity Shadow position always remains authoritative. This observer starts a
  29:  * separate counterfactual position only after the existing PositionContinuationPolicy has already
  30:  * returned FAIL at a reached take-profit checkpoint. Existing continuation PASS paths therefore
  31:  * remain untouched and continue to extend take profit exactly as before.
  32:  *
  33:  * The counterfactual holds through one specific NEUTRAL 1m candle without moving TP. The grace is
  34:  * tied to that candle (not one live-price tick), may be consumed only once per position lifetime,
  35:  * and normal shared continuation/exit policies resume after a new 1m candle arrives.
  36:  */
  37: @Slf4j
  38: @Service
  39: @RequiredArgsConstructor
  40: public class OneCandleContinuationGraceReplayObserver {
  41:     private static final MathContext MC = MathContext.DECIMAL64;
  42: 
  43:     private final JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;
  44:     private final PositionContinuationPolicy continuationPolicy;
  45:     private final PositionExitPolicy exitPolicy;
  46:     private final ProfitLockPolicy profitLockPolicy;
  47:     private final TradeExecutionValidationService executionValidationService;
  48:     private final WalletSettingsRepository walletSettingsRepository;
  49: 
  50:     private final Map<Long, Variant> activeByRun = new HashMap<>();
  51:     private final Map<Long, java.util.Set<Long>> consumedByRun = new HashMap<>();
  52: 
  53:     public synchronized void startRun(long runId, String symbol) {
  54:         activeByRun.remove(runId);
  55:         consumedByRun.put(runId, new java.util.HashSet<>());
  56:         log.info("FIX11Q_GRACE_START runId={} symbol={} mode=REPLAY_COUNTERFACTUAL productionMutation=false baselineReplayMutation=false", runId, symbol);
  57:     }

  59:     public synchronized void observeBaselineTakeProfitFailure(
  60:             long runId, String symbol, long positionId, Instant observedAt, BigDecimal price,
  61:             Instant entryTime, BigDecimal entryPrice, BigDecimal quantity, BigDecimal cost,
  62:             BigDecimal stopLoss, BigDecimal takeProfit, BigDecimal highest,
  63:             boolean profitLockActive, BigDecimal profitLockPrice,
  64:             int entryScore, int entryConfidence, int entryTrend, int entryStructure,
  65:             int entryMomentum, int entryVolume,
  66:             TradeSignal current1m, TradeSignal fiveMinute, TradeSignal oneHour,
  67:             String baselineExplanation) {
  68: 
  69:         if (activeByRun.containsKey(runId) || consumedByRun.getOrDefault(runId, java.util.Set.of()).contains(positionId)) return;
  70:         if (!eligible(current1m, fiveMinute, oneHour, entryMomentum)) return;
  71: 
  72:         Instant candleIdentity = candleIdentity(current1m);
  73:         if (candleIdentity == null) return;
  74:         BigDecimal baselinePnl = price.multiply(quantity, MC).subtract(cost, MC);
  75:         BigDecimal baselinePnlPct = percentage(entryPrice, price);
  76:         BigDecimal safeHighest = highest == null ? price : highest.max(price);
  77: 
  78:         Variant v = new Variant(positionId, symbol, entryTime, entryPrice, quantity, cost, stopLoss,
  79:                 takeProfit, safeHighest, profitLockActive, profitLockPrice,
  80:                 entryScore, entryConfidence, entryTrend, entryStructure, entryMomentum, entryVolume,
  81:                 candleIdentity, current1m == null ? null : current1m.getId(), observedAt, price,
  82:                 baselinePnl, baselinePnlPct, price, price, current1m, fiveMinute, oneHour);
  83:         activeByRun.put(runId, v);
  84:         consumedByRun.computeIfAbsent(runId, k -> new java.util.HashSet<>()).add(positionId);
  85: 
  86:         jdbcTemplate.update("""
  87:                 INSERT INTO one_candle_continuation_grace_test
  88:                 (test_run_id,position_test_id,symbol,grace_at,grace_1m_signal_id,grace_candle_time,
  89:                  price_at_grace,entry_price,take_profit_before_grace,take_profit_after_grace,
  90:                  current_1m_decision,five_minute_decision,one_hour_decision,trend_score,trend_floor,
  91:                  momentum_score,momentum_floor,baseline_action,baseline_exit_price,baseline_pnl_usdt,
  92:                  baseline_pnl_percent,status,baseline_explanation)
  93:                 VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
  94:                 """, runId, positionId, symbol, Timestamp.from(observedAt), v.graceSignalId(), Timestamp.from(candleIdentity),
  95:                 price, entryPrice, takeProfit, takeProfit, name(current1m.getDecision()), name(fiveMinute.getDecision()),
  96:                 name(oneHour.getDecision()), current1m.getTrendScore(), trendFloor(entryTrend),
  97:                 current1m.getMomentumScore(), momentumFloor(entryMomentum), "TAKE_PROFIT_EXIT", price,
  98:                 baselinePnl, baselinePnlPct, "ACTIVE", baselineExplanation);
  99: 
 100:         log.info("FIX11Q_GRACE_ACTIVATED runId={} positionId={} symbol={} observedAt={} candle={} price={} tp={} current={} five={} one={} trend={}/{} momentum={}/{} action=HOLD_TARGET_UNCHANGED",
 101:                 runId, positionId, symbol, observedAt, candleIdentity, price, takeProfit,
 102:                 name(current1m.getDecision()), name(fiveMinute.getDecision()), name(oneHour.getDecision()),
 103:                 current1m.getTrendScore(), trendFloor(entryTrend), current1m.getMomentumScore(), momentumFloor(entryMomentum));

 106:     public synchronized void onSignal(long runId, TradeSignal signal, TradeSignal latest1m, TradeSignal latest5m, TradeSignal latest1h) {
 107:         Variant v = activeByRun.get(runId);
 108:         if (v == null || signal == null) return;
 109:         if ("1m".equals(signal.getInterval()) && v.next1mDecision() == null && !sameGraceCandle(v, signal)) {
 110:             v = v.withNext1m(name(signal.getDecision()));
 111:         }
 112:         if ("5m".equals(signal.getInterval()) && v.next5mDecision() == null && signal.getGeneratedAt() != null && signal.getGeneratedAt().isAfter(v.graceAt())) {
 113:             v = v.withNext5m(name(signal.getDecision()));
 114:         }
 115:         if ("1h".equals(signal.getInterval()) && v.next1hDecision() == null && signal.getGeneratedAt() != null && signal.getGeneratedAt().isAfter(v.graceAt())) {
 116:             v = v.withNext1h(name(signal.getDecision()));
 117:         }
 118:         activeByRun.put(runId, v.withContext(latest1m, latest5m, latest1h));
 119:     }
 120: 
 121:     public synchronized void onPrice(long runId, String symbol, MarketPriceEventService.PriceEvent event,
 122:                                      TradeSignal latest1m, TradeSignal latest5m, TradeSignal latest1h) {
 123:         Variant v = activeByRun.get(runId);
 124:         if (v == null || event == null || event.price() == null || !v.symbol().equals(symbol)) return;
 125:         if (!event.observedAt().isAfter(v.graceAt())) return;
 126: 
 127:         BigDecimal price = event.price();
 128:         v = v.withContext(latest1m, latest5m, latest1h).withPath(price);
 129:         boolean sameGraceCandle = sameGraceCandle(v, latest1m);
 130: 
 131:         // Hard protection remains active even during grace; FIX-11Q suppresses only the baseline
 132:         // TAKE_PROFIT exit caused by transient continuation failure.
 133:         if (v.stopLoss() != null && price.compareTo(v.stopLoss()) <= 0) {
 134:             close(runId, v, event.observedAt(), price, "STOP_LOSS", "Stop loss reached during/after grace."); return;
 135:         }
 136: 
 137:         v = updateProfitLock(v, price);
 138:         if (v.profitLockActive() && v.profitLockPrice() != null && price.compareTo(v.profitLockPrice()) <= 0) {
 139:             BigDecimal hardFloor = v.entryPrice().multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(1.0005), MC);
 140:             if (price.compareTo(hardFloor) < 0) {
 141:                 close(runId, v, event.observedAt(), price, "PROFIT_LOCK_HARD_EXIT", "Profit-lock hard floor breached in FIX-11Q counterfactual."); return;
 142:             }
 143:             PositionExitPolicy.Evaluation lock = exitPolicy.evaluateProfitLockBreach(latest1m, latest5m, latest1h);
 144:             if (lock.exit()) { close(runId, v, event.observedAt(), price, lock.code(), lock.explanation()); return; }
 145:         }
 146: 
 147:         if (v.takeProfit() != null && price.compareTo(v.takeProfit()) >= 0) {
 148:             if (sameGraceCandle) {
 149:                 activeByRun.put(runId, v); // hold entire candle; target intentionally unchanged
 150:                 return;
 151:             }
 152:             PositionContinuationPolicy.Evaluation continuation = continuationPolicy.evaluate(
 153:                     latest1m, latest5m, latest1h, v.entryTrend(), v.entryStructure(), v.entryMomentum(), v.entryVolume(),
 154:                     v.entryConfidence(), v.entryScore());
 155:             if (continuation.extendTarget()) {
 156:                 BigDecimal distance = v.takeProfit().subtract(v.entryPrice());
 157:                 BigDecimal newTarget = v.takeProfit().add(distance.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50), MC), MC);
 158:                 activeByRun.put(runId, v.withTakeProfit(newTarget));
 159:                 log.info("FIX11Q_VARIANT_TP_EXTENDED runId={} positionId={} oldTp={} newTp={} reason={}", runId, v.positionId(), v.takeProfit(), newTarget, continuation.explanation());
 160:                 return;
 161:             }
 162:             close(runId, v, event.observedAt(), price, "TAKE_PROFIT", continuation.explanation()); return;
 163:         }
 164: 
 165:         if (!sameGraceCandle) {
 166:             PositionExitPolicy.Evaluation normal = exitPolicy.evaluateNormalExit(latest1m, latest5m, latest1h);
 167:             if (normal.exit()) { close(runId, v, event.observedAt(), price, normal.code(), normal.explanation()); return; }
 168:             if (latest1m != null && "1m".equals(latest1m.getInterval()) && bearish(latest1m.getDecision())) {
 169:                 TradeExecutionValidationService.ValidationResult validated = executionValidationService.validateSell(latest1m);
 170:                 if (validated.allowed()) { close(runId, v, event.observedAt(), price, validated.code(), validated.explanation()); return; }
 171:             }
 172:         }
 173:         activeByRun.put(runId, v);
 174:     }

 708:     @Transactional(readOnly = true)
 709:     public Map<String, Object> provenTradeChart(String symbol, String interval) {
 710:         String normalized = symbol == null ? "" : symbol.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
 711:         String normalizedInterval = switch (interval == null ? "5m" : interval.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
 712:             case "1m", "5m", "1h", "4h" -> interval.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
 713:             default -> "5m";
 714:         };
 715:         List<Map<String, Object>> trades = jdbcTemplate.queryForList("""
 716:                 SELECT id, source_test_run_id, source_trade_id, symbol, entry_time, entry_price, exit_time, exit_price,
 717:                        exit_reason, realized_pnl_usdt, realized_pnl_percent, position_percent, marked_at
 718:                 FROM proven_analyzed_trade
 719:                 WHERE symbol = ?
 720:                 ORDER BY entry_time ASC
 721:                 LIMIT 250
 722:                 """, normalized);
 723:         java.util.LinkedHashMap<String, Map<String, Object>> candles = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
 724:         for (Map<String, Object> trade : trades) {
 725:             Timestamp entry = (Timestamp) trade.get("entry_time");
 726:             Timestamp exit = (Timestamp) trade.get("exit_time");
 727:             if (entry == null) continue;
 728:             // Proven-analysis charts intentionally use real historical candles with a wide context window.
 729:             // Keep seven hours before the BUY and seven hours after the SELL so manual review can
 730:             // detect late entries and premature exits instead of judging only the replay window.
 731:             Instant from = entry.toInstant().minus(java.time.Duration.ofHours(7));
 732:             Instant to = (exit == null ? entry.toInstant() : exit.toInstant()).plus(java.time.Duration.ofHours(7));
 733:             List<Map<String, Object>> segment = candleReader(jdbcTemplate).queryForList("""
 734:                     SELECT open_time, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume
 735:                     FROM candle
 736:                     WHERE symbol=? AND interval_code=? AND closed=1 AND open_time BETWEEN ? AND ?
 737:                     ORDER BY open_time ASC
 738:                     """, normalized, normalizedInterval, Timestamp.from(from), Timestamp.from(to));
 739:             for (Map<String, Object> c : segment) candles.put(String.valueOf(c.get("open_time")), c);
 740:         }
 741:         return Map.of("symbol", normalized, "interval", normalizedInterval, "trades", trades,
 742:                 "candles", new java.util.ArrayList<>(candles.values()));
 743:     }

===== src/main/java/com/crypto/inspector/service/TradeInvestmentHistory.java 1-180 =====
   1: package com.crypto.inspector.service;
   2: 
   3: import org.slf4j.Logger;
   4: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
   5: import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
   6: 
   7: import java.math.BigDecimal;
   8: import java.math.RoundingMode;
   9: import java.sql.Timestamp;
  10: import java.time.Instant;
  11: import java.time.LocalDateTime;
  12: import java.time.ZoneOffset;
  13: import java.util.*;
  14: 
  15: /**
  16:  * FIX-121: read-only historical investment reporting. No wallet or Replay mutation.
  17:  * A position is a flat-to-flat execution sequence, including partial SELLs and adds.
  18:  * Never pair one convenient BUY with a terminal SELL or infer cost from realized P/L.
  19:  * Instances are request-local: cached ledgers must never leak between requests/runs.
  20:  */
  21: public final class TradeInvestmentHistory {
  22:     private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(TradeInvestmentHistory.class);
  23:     private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
  24:     private final Map<String, List<Leg>> ledgers = new HashMap<>();
  25:     private final Map<List<Leg>, List<Position>> resolved = new IdentityHashMap<>();
  26: 
  27:     public TradeInvestmentHistory(JdbcTemplate jdbc) { this.jdbc = jdbc; }
  28: 
  29:     /** Decimal strings preserve all backend precision through JSON and browser rendering. */
  30:     public record Investment(String entryQuantity, String unitEntryPriceUsdt, String totalInvestedUsdt,
  31:                              int buyCount, String status, String explanation) {
  32:         public static Investment unavailable(String reason) {
  33:             return new Investment(null, null, null, 0, "UNAVAILABLE", reason);
  34:         }
  35:     }
  36: 
  37:     public record Leg(long id, String symbol, String side, Instant time, BigDecimal quantity,
  38:                       BigDecimal price, BigDecimal amount, Long signalId) {}
  39:     public record Position(List<Leg> legs, BigDecimal remaining, Investment investment) {
  40:         Leg first() { return legs.get(0); }
  41:         Leg last() { return legs.get(legs.size() - 1); }
  42:     }
  43: 
  44:     public Investment closedWallet(String symbol, long sellId) {
  45:         return report("WALLET", String.valueOf(sellId), unique(partition(wallet(symbol)).stream()
  46:                 .filter(p -> p.last().id() == sellId && "SELL".equals(p.last().side()) && p.remaining().signum() == 0).toList()));
  47:     }
  48: 
  49:     public Investment openWallet(String symbol, Long entrySignalId, BigDecimal remaining) {
  50:         List<Position> matches = partition(wallet(symbol)).stream()
  51:                 .filter(p -> p.remaining().signum() > 0 && entrySignalId != null
  52:                         && entrySignalId.equals(p.first().signalId()))
  53:                 .filter(p -> remaining != null && closeEnough(p.remaining(), remaining, p.legs().size()))
  54:                 .toList();
  55:         return report("WALLET_OPEN", String.valueOf(entrySignalId), unique(matches));
  56:     }
  57: 
  58:     public List<Leg> closedWalletLegs(String symbol, long sellId) {
  59:         return partition(wallet(symbol)).stream().filter(p -> p.last().id() == sellId
  60:                 && p.remaining().signum() == 0).findFirst().map(Position::legs).orElse(List.of());
  61:     }
  62: 
  63:     private List<Position> partition(List<Leg> legs) {
  64:         return resolved.computeIfAbsent(legs, TradeInvestmentHistory::positions);
  65:     }
  66: 
  67:     private List<Leg> wallet(String symbol) {
  68:         if (symbol == null) return List.of();
  69:         return ledgers.computeIfAbsent("W:" + symbol, key -> read("""
  70:                 SELECT id, symbol, side, executed_at AS execution_time, quantity,
  71:                        price_usdt AS execution_price, gross_amount_usdt AS notional_usdt, signal_id
  72:                 FROM wallet_trade WHERE symbol=? AND status='EXECUTED'
  73:                   AND side IN ('BUY','SELL') ORDER BY executed_at,id
  74:                 """, symbol));
  75:     }
  76: 
  77:     /** Run/archive identity is part of the lookup; same-symbol executions in other runs cannot enter. */
  78:     public void enrichReplay(List<Map<String, Object>> trades, Long archiveBatchId) {
  79:         for (Map<String, Object> trade : trades) trade.put("investment", replay(trade, archiveBatchId));
  80:     }
  81: 
  82:     public Investment replay(Map<String, Object> trade, Long archiveBatchId) {
  83:         Object runId = trade.get("test_run_id");
  84:         String symbol = Objects.toString(trade.get("symbol"), "");
  85:         if (runId == null || symbol.isEmpty()) return Investment.unavailable("Replay source identity is missing.");
  86:         String key = "R:" + archiveBatchId + ":" + runId + ":" + symbol;
  87:         List<Leg> legs = ledgers.computeIfAbsent(key, ignored -> archiveBatchId == null
  88:                 ? read("SELECT id,symbol,side,execution_time,quantity,execution_price,notional_usdt FROM wallet_execution_test WHERE test_run_id=? AND symbol=? ORDER BY execution_time,id", runId, symbol)
  89:                 : read("SELECT id,symbol,side,execution_time,quantity,execution_price,notional_usdt FROM wallet_execution_test_archive WHERE archive_batch_id=? AND test_run_id=? AND symbol=? ORDER BY execution_time,id", archiveBatchId, runId, symbol));
  90:         Instant entry = instant(trade.get("entry_time")), exit = instant(trade.get("exit_time"));
  91:         List<Position> matches = partition(legs).stream()
  92:                 .filter(p -> Objects.equals(p.first().time(), entry))
  93:                 .filter(p -> exit == null ? p.remaining().signum() > 0
  94:                         : p.remaining().signum() == 0 && Objects.equals(p.last().time(), exit))
  95:                 .toList();
  96:         return report("REPLAY", runId + ":" + trade.get("id"), unique(matches));
  97:     }
  98: 
  99:     /** Proven records keep their original source; archives and saved execution points are fallback evidence. */
 100:     public void enrichProven(List<Map<String, Object>> trades) {
 101:         for (Map<String, Object> trade : trades) {
 102:             Investment result;
 103:             if (trade.get("source_wallet_sell_trade_id") instanceof Number sell) {
 104:                 result = closedWallet(Objects.toString(trade.get("symbol"), ""), sell.longValue());
 105:                 if (!"AVAILABLE".equals(result.status())) {
 106:                     List<Leg> saved = read("""
 107:                             SELECT wallet_trade_id AS id, ? AS symbol,side,execution_time,quantity,execution_price
 108:                             FROM proven_trade_execution_point WHERE proven_trade_id=? ORDER BY sequence_no,execution_time
 109:                             """, trade.get("symbol"), trade.get("id"));
 110:                     result = report("PROVEN_POINTS", String.valueOf(trade.get("id")), closed(saved, sell.longValue()));
 111:                 }
 112:             } else if (trade.get("source_test_run_id") != null && trade.get("source_trade_id") != null) {
 113:                 Map<String, Object> source = new HashMap<>(trade);
 114:                 source.put("test_run_id", trade.get("source_test_run_id"));
 115:                 source.put("id", trade.get("source_trade_id"));
 116:                 result = replay(source, null);
 117:                 if (!"AVAILABLE".equals(result.status())) {

 156:         List<Position> result = new ArrayList<>();

 158:             ledger.sort(Comparator.comparing(Leg::time, Comparator.nullsFirst(Comparator.naturalOrder())).thenComparingLong(Leg::id));
 159:             List<Leg> current = new ArrayList<>();

 161:             Set<Long> ids = new HashSet<>();

 163:             for (Leg leg : ledger) {
 164:                 if (leg.time() == null || leg.id() < 0 || !ids.add(leg.id()) || leg.quantity() == null
 165:                         || leg.quantity().signum() <= 0 || !("BUY".equals(leg.side()) || "SELL".equals(leg.side()))) {
 166:                     invalid = true; break;

 169:                 balance = "BUY".equals(leg.side()) ? balance.add(leg.quantity()) : balance.subtract(leg.quantity());

 171:                     BigDecimal acquired = current.stream().filter(x -> "BUY".equals(x.side()))
 172:                             .map(Leg::quantity).reduce(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal::add);
 173:                     BigDecimal storageRounding = new BigDecimal("0.000000000001").multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(current.size()));

 175:                     if (balance.abs().compareTo(tolerance) <= 0) balance = BigDecimal.ZERO;
 176:                 }
 177:                 if (balance.signum() < 0) { invalid = true; break; }
 178:                 if (balance.signum() == 0) {
 179:                     result.add(new Position(List.copyOf(current), balance, aggregate(current)));
 180:                     current.clear();

===== src/main/java/com/crypto/wallet/service/BinanceMinimumExecutionPolicy.java 1-100 =====
   1: package com.crypto.wallet.service;
   2: 
   3: import com.crypto.client.binance.BinanceMarketDataClient;
   4: import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
   5: import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
   6: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
   7: 
   8: import java.math.BigDecimal;
   9: import java.math.MathContext;
  10: import java.util.Locale;
  11: 
  12: /**
  13:  * FIX-11T minimum-executable-order guard shared by Production Paper and Replay.
  14:  *
  15:  * The project intentionally models Paper/Replay as real Binance trading with only the
  16:  * final connector missing.  Therefore a Near-TP partial harvest that Binance would reject
  17:  * for being below the symbol's minimum notional is not simulated.  No alternative exit
  18:  * size is invented: the position simply continues through its existing management logic.
  19:  *
  20:  * This class deliberately checks only the agreed minimum executable notional boundary.
  21:  * It does not add a new Near-TP-specific step-size/precision model.
  22:  */
  23: @Component
  24: @RequiredArgsConstructor
  25: @Slf4j
  26: public class BinanceMinimumExecutionPolicy {
  27:     private static final MathContext MC = MathContext.DECIMAL64;
  28: 
  29:     private final BinanceMarketDataClient binanceMarketDataClient;
  30:     public Evaluation evaluate(String symbol, BigDecimal quantity, BigDecimal price) {
  31:         if (symbol == null || symbol.isBlank() || quantity == null || quantity.signum() <= 0
  32:                 || price == null || price.signum() <= 0) {
  33:             return new Evaluation(false, "INVALID_ORDER_INPUT", BigDecimal.ZERO, null);
  34:         }
  35:         String pair = symbol.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
  36:         BigDecimal notional = quantity.multiply(price, MC);
  37:         BigDecimal minimum;
  38:         try {
  39:             minimum = binanceMarketDataClient.getMinimumExecutableNotional(pair);
  40:         } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
  41:             // Fail safe. Missing exchange constraints must never be converted into permission
  42:             // to create an order that real Binance might reject.
  43:             log.warn("FIX-11T Binance minimum executable amount unavailable: symbol={}, requestedNotional={}, error={}",
  44:                     pair, notional, ex.getMessage());
  45:             return new Evaluation(false, "BINANCE_MINIMUM_UNAVAILABLE", notional, null);
  46:         }
  47:         if (notional.compareTo(minimum) < 0) {
  48:             return new Evaluation(false, "BELOW_BINANCE_MINIMUM", notional, minimum);
  49:         }
  50:         return new Evaluation(true, "EXECUTABLE", notional, minimum);
  51:     }
  52: 
  53:     public record Evaluation(boolean executable, String code, BigDecimal requestedNotional, BigDecimal minimumNotional) {
  54:     }
  55: }

 153:     /**
 154:      * FIX-11T: read the symbol's current Binance minimum executable notional directly
 155:      * from exchangeInfo.  Near-TP uses this only as a minimum-order guard; it does not
 156:      * introduce a separate quantity-rounding model. NOTIONAL is preferred when present,
 157:      * with MIN_NOTIONAL retained for symbols that still expose the older filter.
 158:      */
 159:     public BigDecimal getMinimumExecutableNotional(String symbol) {
 160:         if (symbol == null || symbol.isBlank()) {
 161:             throw new IllegalArgumentException("Symbol is required");
 162:         }
 163: 
 164:         Map<String, Object> response = request(() -> restClient.get()
 165:             .uri(uriBuilder -> uriBuilder
 166:                 .path("/api/v3/exchangeInfo")
 167:                 .queryParam("symbol", symbol.toUpperCase())
 168:                 .build())
 169:             .retrieve()
 170:             .body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {
 171:             }));
 172: 
 173:         if (response == null) {
 174:             throw new IllegalStateException("Empty Binance exchangeInfo response for " + symbol);
 175:         }
 176:         Object symbolsValue = response.get("symbols");
 177:         if (!(symbolsValue instanceof List<?> symbols) || symbols.isEmpty() || !(symbols.get(0) instanceof Map<?, ?> symbolInfo)) {
 178:             throw new IllegalStateException("Binance exchangeInfo did not contain symbol rules for " + symbol);
 179:         }
 180:         Object filtersValue = symbolInfo.get("filters");
 181:         if (!(filtersValue instanceof List<?> filters)) {
 182:             throw new IllegalStateException("Binance exchangeInfo did not contain filters for " + symbol);
 183:         }
 184: 
 185:         BigDecimal minNotional = null;
 186:         for (Object filterValue : filters) {
 187:             if (!(filterValue instanceof Map<?, ?> filter)) continue;
 188:             String filterType = String.valueOf(filter.get("filterType"));
 189:             if (!"NOTIONAL".equals(filterType) && !"MIN_NOTIONAL".equals(filterType)) continue;
 190:             Object raw = filter.get("minNotional");
 191:             if (raw == null) continue;
 192:             BigDecimal candidate = new BigDecimal(String.valueOf(raw));
 193:             if (candidate.signum() <= 0) continue;
 194:             if ("NOTIONAL".equals(filterType)) return candidate;
 195:             minNotional = candidate;

  46:     /** Strategy-aware final evaluation. */
  47:     public MultiTimeframeConfluenceResult evaluate(
  48:             String symbol,
  49:             String interval,
  50:             SignalDecision currentDecision,
  51:             Instant evaluationTime,
  52:             TradingStrategy strategy
  53:     ) {
  54:         Instant snapshotTime = evaluationTime == null ? Instant.now() : evaluationTime;
  55:         List<String> higherIntervals = higherIntervals(interval);
  56:         if (higherIntervals.isEmpty()) {
  57:             return unavailable(currentDecision, snapshotTime,
  58:                     "No higher-timeframe mapping is configured for " + interval + ".");
  59:         }
  60: 
  61:         List<TradeSignal> contexts = higherIntervals.stream()
  62:                 .map(higher -> contextAtOrBefore(symbol, higher, snapshotTime))
  63:                 .filter(signal -> signal != null && isFresh(signal, snapshotTime))
  64:                 .toList();
  65: 
  66:         if(contextMetrics!=null)contextMetrics.record("MTF",interval,higherIntervals.size(),contexts.size());
  67:         if (contexts.isEmpty()) {
  68:             return unavailable(currentDecision, snapshotTime,
  69:                     "No recent closed higher-timeframe signal was available at signal creation time; "
  70:                             + "the isolated decision was preserved with reduced confidence.");
  71:         }
  72: 
  73:         TradeSignal strongestContext = contexts.stream()
  74:                 .max((left, right) -> Integer.compare(contextStrength(left), contextStrength(right)))
  75:                 .orElseThrow();
  76: 
  77:         ContextCounts counts = count(contexts);
  78:         TradingStrategy activeStrategy = strategy == null ? TradingStrategy.TREND_FOLLOWING : strategy;
  79:         Evaluation evaluation = switch (activeStrategy) {
  80:             case TREND_FOLLOWING -> trendFollowing(currentDecision, contexts, counts);
  81:             case RANGE_MEAN_REVERSION -> rangeMeanReversion(currentDecision, contexts, counts);
  82:             case BREAKOUT -> breakout(currentDecision, contexts, counts);
  83:             case DEFENSIVE -> defensive(currentDecision, contexts, counts);
  84:             case NO_TRADE -> noTrade(currentDecision);
  85:         };
  86: 
  87:         List<String> reasons = new ArrayList<>(evaluation.reasons());
  88:         reasons.add("Strategy-aware confluence used " + activeStrategy + ".");
  89:         reasons.add(contextSummary(contexts));
  90: 
  91:         return new MultiTimeframeConfluenceResult(
  92:                 evaluation.status(),
  93:                 currentDecision,
  94:                 evaluation.finalDecision(),
  95:                 evaluation.entryAllowed(),
  96:                 strongestContext.getInterval(),
  97:                 strongestContext.getDecision(),
  98:                 strongestContext.getTrendScore(),
  99:                 snapshotTime,
 100:                 strongestContext.getGeneratedAt(),
 101:                 List.copyOf(reasons)
 102:         );
 103:     }

 274:     /**
 275:      * FIX-014 / XRPUSDT 2026-08-19:
 276:      * A fresh 5m BUY transition may wake an already-existing, unexecuted BUY opportunity
 277:      * whose latest 1m timing signal was deferred only by local ATR extension. The 5m signal
 278:      * NEVER becomes wallet execution authority: it only asks the existing SETUP_TIMEFRAME_ATR
 279:      * policy to re-evaluate the latest fresh 1m state. 1h WATCH/BUY authority, current 1m
 280:      * non-bearish timing, all hard risk gates, the existing 5m ATR plan, and Entry Quality
 281:      * remain mandatory. Normal 1m BUY behavior and all existing HTF/ATR routes are unchanged.
 282:      */
 283:     @Transactional
 284:     public SetupWakeupEvaluation evaluateSetupTimeframeWakeup(
 285:             TradeSignal fiveMinuteTrigger, int currentAllocationPercent) {
 286:         if (stopLossEvidence == null) return evaluateSetupTimeframeWakeupInternal(fiveMinuteTrigger, currentAllocationPercent);
 287:         return stopLossEvidence.wakeup(fiveMinuteTrigger, currentAllocationPercent,
 288:                 () -> evaluateSetupTimeframeWakeupInternal(fiveMinuteTrigger, currentAllocationPercent));
 289:     }

 291:     private SetupWakeupEvaluation evaluateSetupTimeframeWakeupInternal(
 292:             TradeSignal fiveMinuteTrigger, int currentAllocationPercent) {
 293:         if (currentAllocationPercent > 0 || fiveMinuteTrigger == null || fiveMinuteTrigger.getGeneratedAt() == null
 294:                 || !CONFIRMATION_INTERVAL.equals(fiveMinuteTrigger.getInterval())
 295:                 || !isBullish(fiveMinuteTrigger.getDecision())
 296:                 || !fiveMinuteTrigger.isFinalEntryAllowed()
 297:                 || !fiveMinuteTrigger.isAtrImmediateEntryAllowed()) {
 298:             return SetupWakeupEvaluation.none();
 299:         }
 300: 
 301:         // Only a real 5m transition can wake the opportunity. Repeated BUY candles remain
 302:         // context-only so this hook cannot create duplicate execution pressure.
 303:         TradeSignal previousFive = previousSignalBefore(
 304:                 fiveMinuteTrigger.getSymbol(), CONFIRMATION_INTERVAL, fiveMinuteTrigger.getGeneratedAt()).orElse(null);
 305:         if (previousFive != null && isBullish(previousFive.getDecision())) {
 306:             return SetupWakeupEvaluation.none();
 307:         }
 308: 
 309:         ExecutionOpportunity opportunity = currentOpportunity(
 310:                 fiveMinuteTrigger.getSymbol(), List.of("BUILDING", "WEAKENING", "BLOCKED", "CONFIRMED"))
 311:                 .filter(o -> o.getExecutedAt() == null)
 312:                 .orElse(null);
 313:         if (opportunity == null) return SetupWakeupEvaluation.none();
 314: 
 315:         TradeSignal current1m = latestSignalAtOrBefore(
 316:                 fiveMinuteTrigger.getSymbol(), EXECUTION_INTERVAL, fiveMinuteTrigger.getGeneratedAt()).orElse(null);
 317:         if (current1m == null || current1m.getGeneratedAt() == null
 318:                 || Duration.between(current1m.getGeneratedAt(), fiveMinuteTrigger.getGeneratedAt())
 319:                         .compareTo(SETUP_WAKEUP_1M_MAX_AGE) > 0) {
 320:             return SetupWakeupEvaluation.none();
 321:         }
 322: 
 323:         // This hook is only for the already-proven SETUP_TIMEFRAME_ATR gap: current 1m timing
 324:         // must still be deferred by ATR. A normal immediate 1m BUY continues through evaluateBuy().
 325:         if (current1m.isAtrImmediateEntryAllowed()
 326:                 || isBearish(current1m.getDecision())
 327:                 || isBearish(current1m.getOriginalDecision())
 328:                 || !current1m.isFinalEntryAllowed()) {
 329:             return SetupWakeupEvaluation.none();
 330:         }

  30:     public StrategyProfile select(MarketRegimeAssessment assessment, MarketContextSnapshot context) {
  31:         if (!properties.isEnabled()) {
  32:             return profile(TradingStrategy.TREND_FOLLOWING, properties.getTrendFollowing(), true,
  33:                     "Dynamic strategy selection is disabled; using the default profile");
  34:         }
  35:         if (context != null && !context.dataValid()) {
  36:             return profile(TradingStrategy.NO_TRADE, properties.getDefensive(), false,
  37:                     "Required market data is invalid or incomplete; new entries are disabled");
  38:         }
  39:         if (context != null && context.liquidityRisky()) {
  40:             return profile(TradingStrategy.DEFENSIVE, properties.getDefensive(), true,
  41:                     "Current order-book liquidity risk selected the defensive profile");
  42:         }
  43:         if (context != null && (context.derivativesStatus() == com.crypto.domain.DerivativesPositioningStatus.LONGS_CROWDED
  44:                 || context.derivativesStatus() == com.crypto.domain.DerivativesPositioningStatus.SHORTS_CROWDED)) {
  45:             return profile(TradingStrategy.DEFENSIVE, properties.getDefensive(), true,
  46:                     "Extreme futures positioning selected the defensive profile");
  47:         }
  48:         if (context != null && context.sentimentEnabled()
  49:                 && context.sentimentCoverage().compareTo(java.math.BigDecimal.valueOf(0.50)) < 0) {
  50:             return profile(TradingStrategy.DEFENSIVE, properties.getDefensive(), true,
  51:                     "Less than half of enabled sentiment providers are contributing; defensive profile selected");
  52:         }
  53:         if (context != null && context.higherTimeframeStatus() == com.crypto.domain.ConfluenceStatus.STRONG_CONFLICT) {
  54:             return profile(TradingStrategy.DEFENSIVE, properties.getDefensive(), true,
  55:                     "Strong higher-timeframe conflict selected the defensive profile");
  56:         }
  57:         if (context != null
  58:                 && context.btcContextStatus() == com.crypto.domain.BtcContextStatus.STRONG_CONFLICT
  59:                 && context.btcInfluenceFactor() != null
  60:                 && context.btcInfluenceFactor().compareTo(java.math.BigDecimal.valueOf(0.70)) >= 0) {
  61:             return profile(TradingStrategy.DEFENSIVE, properties.getDefensive(), true,
  62:                     "Strong BTC conflict for a highly correlated asset selected the defensive profile");
  63:         }
  64:         if (assessment.confidence() < properties.getMinimumRegimeConfidence()) {
  65:             return profile(TradingStrategy.DEFENSIVE, properties.getDefensive(), true,
  66:                     "Regime confidence is below the configured minimum; defensive profile selected");
  67:         }
  68: 
  69:         return switch (assessment.regime()) {
  70:             case STRONG_UPTREND, WEAK_UPTREND, STRONG_DOWNTREND, WEAK_DOWNTREND ->
  71:                     profile(TradingStrategy.TREND_FOLLOWING, properties.getTrendFollowing(), true,
  72:                             "Directional market structure selected the trend-following profile");
  73:             case RANGE -> profile(TradingStrategy.RANGE_MEAN_REVERSION, properties.getRangeMeanReversion(), true,
  74:                     "Range conditions selected the mean-reversion profile");
  75:             case BREAKOUT -> profile(TradingStrategy.BREAKOUT, properties.getBreakout(), true,
  76:                     "Price expansion, volume and structural confirmation selected the breakout profile");
  77:             case BREAKOUT_CANDIDATE -> profile(TradingStrategy.BREAKOUT, properties.getBreakout(), true,
  78:                     "Price expansion and volume detected an early breakout candidate; structural confirmation is still pending");
  79:             case HIGH_VOLATILITY, LOW_LIQUIDITY -> profile(TradingStrategy.DEFENSIVE, properties.getDefensive(), true,
  80:                     "Risk conditions selected the defensive profile");
  81:             case UNKNOWN -> profile(TradingStrategy.NO_TRADE, properties.getDefensive(), false,
  82:                     "Market regime is unknown; new entries are disabled");
  83:         };
  84:     }

  86:     public StrategyScoreResult score(
  87:             StrategyProfile profile,
  88:             int baseTrend,
  89:             int baseVolume,
  90:             int baseMomentum,
  91:             int baseSentiment,
  92:             int baseFundamentals,
  93:             boolean sentimentAvailable,
  94:             boolean fundamentalAvailable
  95:     ) {
  96:         int trend = scale(baseTrend, BASE_TREND_MAX, profile.trendMaximum());
  97:         int volume = scale(baseVolume, BASE_VOLUME_MAX, profile.volumeMaximum());
  98:         int momentum = scale(baseMomentum, BASE_MOMENTUM_MAX, profile.momentumMaximum());
  99:         int sentiment = sentimentAvailable
 100:                 ? scale(baseSentiment, BASE_SENTIMENT_MAX, profile.sentimentMaximum()) : 0;
 101:         int fundamentals = fundamentalAvailable
 102:                 ? scale(baseFundamentals, BASE_FUNDAMENTAL_MAX, profile.fundamentalMaximum()) : 0;
 103:         int raw = trend + volume + momentum + sentiment + fundamentals;
 104:         int maximum = profile.maximum(sentimentAvailable, fundamentalAvailable);
 105:         int normalized = maximum <= 0 ? 0 : (int) Math.round(raw * 100.0 / maximum);
 106:         SignalDecision decision = decision(normalized, profile);
 107: 
 108:         if (!profile.entryAllowed() && (decision == SignalDecision.BUY || decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY)) {
 109:             decision = SignalDecision.WATCH;
 110:         }
 111:         return new StrategyScoreResult(trend, volume, momentum, sentiment, fundamentals,
 112:                 raw, maximum, normalized, decision);
 113:     }
 114: 
 115: 
 116:     /**
 117:      * A BREAKOUT_CANDIDATE may use breakout weights for diagnostics, but it cannot
 118:      * become an ordinary full BUY solely through score normalization. It must first
 119:      * pass the existing early-breakout promotion path.
 120:      */
 121:     public StrategyScoreResult constrainBreakoutCandidate(
 122:             MarketRegimeAssessment assessment,
 123:             StrategyScoreResult score
 124:     ) {
 125:         if (assessment == null || score == null
 126:                 || assessment.regime() != MarketRegime.BREAKOUT_CANDIDATE) {
 127:             return score;
 128:         }
 129:         if (score.decision() != SignalDecision.BUY && score.decision() != SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY) {
 130:             return score;
 131:         }
 132:         return new StrategyScoreResult(
 133:                 score.trendScore(), score.volumeScore(), score.momentumScore(),
 134:                 score.sentimentScore(), score.fundamentalScore(), score.rawScore(),
 135:                 score.maximumScore(), score.normalizedScore(), SignalDecision.WATCH);
 136:     }
 137: 
 138:     /**
 139:      * Promotes only a technically strong early BREAKOUT WATCH. The normal BUY threshold stays
 140:      * untouched (80 by configuration). ATR and higher-timeframe context are required here so
 141:      * the promotion cannot bypass entry-risk or 1m/5m/1h safety checks.
 142:      */
 143:     public StrategyScoreResult promoteEarlyBreakout(
 144:             StrategyProfile profile,
 145:             StrategyScoreResult score,
 146:             MarketContextSnapshot context,
 147:             com.crypto.dto.AtrRiskAssessment atrRisk,
 148:             MarketRegimeAssessment regimeAssessment,
 149:             com.crypto.dto.TrendStructureResult trendStructure
 150:     ) {
 151:         if (profile == null || score == null || profile.strategy() != TradingStrategy.BREAKOUT
 152:                 || score.decision() != SignalDecision.WATCH) {
 153:             return score;
 154:         }
 155: 
 156:         boolean higherTimeframeSafe = context != null
 157:                 && context.higherTimeframeStatus() != com.crypto.domain.ConfluenceStatus.UNAVAILABLE
 158:                 && context.higherTimeframeStatus() != com.crypto.domain.ConfluenceStatus.CONFLICT
 159:                 && context.higherTimeframeStatus() != com.crypto.domain.ConfluenceStatus.STRONG_CONFLICT;
 160:         boolean atrAllowsEntry = atrRisk != null && atrRisk.immediateEntryAllowed();
 161: 
 162:         // An unconfirmed candidate needs at least genuine breakout preparation
 163:         // (compression or equivalent structure evidence) before the early-probe
 164:         // promotion is allowed. This specifically prevents a tiny Bollinger poke
 165:         // plus RVOL from jumping directly to BUY.
 166:         if (regimeAssessment != null
 167:                 && regimeAssessment.regime() == MarketRegime.BREAKOUT_CANDIDATE
 168:                 && (trendStructure == null || trendStructure.breakoutPreparationScore() <= 0)) {
 169:             return score;
 170:         }
 171: 
 172:         return promoteEarlyBreakout(profile, score, higherTimeframeSafe, atrAllowsEntry);
 173:     }
 174: 
 175:     StrategyScoreResult promoteEarlyBreakout(
 176:             StrategyProfile profile,
 177:             StrategyScoreResult score,
 178:             boolean higherTimeframeSafe,
 179:             boolean atrAllowsEntry
 180:     ) {
 181:         if (profile == null || score == null || profile.strategy() != TradingStrategy.BREAKOUT
 182:                 || score.decision() != SignalDecision.WATCH) {
 183:             return score;
 184:         }
 185:         boolean strongTechnicalBreakout = score.normalizedScore() >= 70
 186:                 && percent(score.trendScore(), profile.trendMaximum()) >= 60
 187:                 && percent(score.volumeScore(), profile.volumeMaximum()) >= 80
 188:                 && percent(score.momentumScore(), profile.momentumMaximum()) >= 85;
 189:         if (!strongTechnicalBreakout || !higherTimeframeSafe || !atrAllowsEntry || !profile.entryAllowed()) {
 190:             return score;
 191:         }
 192:         return new StrategyScoreResult(
 193:                 score.trendScore(), score.volumeScore(), score.momentumScore(),
 194:                 score.sentimentScore(), score.fundamentalScore(), score.rawScore(),
 195:                 score.maximumScore(), score.normalizedScore(), SignalDecision.BUY);
 196:     }
 197: 
 198:     private int percent(int score, int maximum) {
 199:         return maximum <= 0 ? 0 : (int) Math.round(score * 100.0 / maximum);
 200:     }
 201: 
 202:     private StrategyProfile profile(TradingStrategy strategy, DynamicStrategyProperties.Profile p,
 203:                                     boolean entryAllowed, String explanation) {
 204:         return new StrategyProfile(strategy, properties.getVersion(),
 205:                 p.getTrendMaximum(), p.getVolumeMaximum(), p.getMomentumMaximum(),
 206:                 p.getSentimentMaximum(), p.getFundamentalMaximum(),
 207:                 p.getStrongBuyThreshold(), p.getBuyThreshold(), p.getWatchThreshold(),
 208:                 p.getNeutralThreshold(), p.getSellThreshold(), entryAllowed, explanation);
 209:     }
 210: 
 211:     private int scale(int score, int oldMaximum, int newMaximum) {
 212:         if (oldMaximum <= 0 || newMaximum <= 0) return 0;
 213:         return Math.max(0, Math.min(newMaximum,
 214:                 (int) Math.round(score * (double) newMaximum / oldMaximum)));
 215:     }
 216: 
 217:     private SignalDecision decision(int score, StrategyProfile p) {
 218:         if (score >= p.strongBuyThreshold()) return SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY;
 219:         if (score >= p.buyThreshold()) return SignalDecision.BUY;
 220:         if (score >= p.watchThreshold()) return SignalDecision.WATCH;
 221:         if (score >= p.neutralThreshold()) return SignalDecision.NEUTRAL;
 222:         if (score >= p.sellThreshold()) return SignalDecision.SELL;
 223:         return SignalDecision.STRONG_SELL;
 224:     }
 225: }

  22: /**
  23:  * Builds the complete market context before strategy selection.  Directional
  24:  * services are queried with NEUTRAL so they expose context without vetoing a
  25:  * decision that has not yet been calculated.
  26:  */
  27: @Service
  28: @RequiredArgsConstructor
  29: public class MarketContextService {
  30: 
  31:     private final MultiTimeframeConfluenceService multiTimeframeConfluenceService;
  32:     private final BtcMarketContextService btcMarketContextService;
  33:     private final OrderBookLiquidityService orderBookLiquidityService;
  34:     private final DerivativesPositioningService derivativesPositioningService;
  35: 
  36:     public MarketContextSnapshot build(
  37:             IndicatorSnapshot indicator,
  38:             AtrRiskAssessment atrRisk,
  39:             SentimentOverview sentimentOverview,
  40:             boolean sentimentEnabled,
  41:             Instant evaluatedAt,
  42:             boolean historicalReplay
  43:     ) {
  44:         Instant snapshotTime = evaluatedAt == null ? Instant.now() : evaluatedAt;
  45:         MultiTimeframeConfluenceResult timeframe = multiTimeframeConfluenceService.evaluate(
  46:                 indicator.symbol(), indicator.intervalCode(), SignalDecision.NEUTRAL, snapshotTime);
  47:         BtcMarketContextResult btc = btcMarketContextService.evaluate(
  48:                 indicator.symbol(), indicator.intervalCode(), SignalDecision.NEUTRAL, true, snapshotTime);
  49:         OrderBookLiquidityResult liquidity = historicalReplay
  50:                 ? orderBookLiquidityService.evaluateHistorical(
  51:                         indicator.symbol(), indicator.intervalCode(), SignalDecision.NEUTRAL, true,
  52:                         indicator.latestPrice(), atrRisk.stopLoss(), atrRisk.takeProfit(), snapshotTime)
  53:                 : orderBookLiquidityService.evaluate(
  54:                         indicator.symbol(), indicator.intervalCode(), SignalDecision.NEUTRAL, true, indicator.latestPrice(),
  55:                         atrRisk.stopLoss(), atrRisk.takeProfit(), snapshotTime);
  56:         DerivativesPositioningResult derivatives = historicalReplay
  57:                 ? derivativesPositioningService.evaluateHistorical(
  58:                         indicator.symbol(), indicator.intervalCode(), SignalDecision.NEUTRAL, true, snapshotTime)
  59:                 : derivativesPositioningService.evaluate(
  60:                         indicator.symbol(), indicator.intervalCode(), SignalDecision.NEUTRAL, true, snapshotTime);
  61: 
  62:         List<ProviderSentiment> providers = sentimentOverview == null || sentimentOverview.providers() == null
  63:                 ? List.of() : sentimentOverview.providers();
  64:         int enabled = (int) providers.stream().filter(ProviderSentiment::enabled).count();
  65:         int contributing = (int) providers.stream()
  66:                 .filter(ProviderSentiment::enabled)
  67:                 .filter(provider -> provider.effectiveWeight() != null && provider.effectiveWeight().signum() > 0)
  68:                 .count();
  69:         BigDecimal coverage = enabled == 0
  70:                 ? (sentimentEnabled ? BigDecimal.ZERO : BigDecimal.ONE)
  71:                 : BigDecimal.valueOf(contributing)
  72:                     .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(enabled), 4, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
  73: 
  74:         boolean valid = indicator.latestPrice() != null && indicator.latestPrice().signum() > 0
  75:                 && indicator.ema20() != null && indicator.ema50() != null && indicator.ema200() != null;
  76:         List<String> evidence = new ArrayList<>();
  77:         evidence.add("Higher-timeframe context: " + timeframe.status());
  78:         evidence.add("BTC relationship/context: " + btc.relationshipType() + " / " + btc.contextStatus());
  79:         evidence.add("Order-book liquidity: " + liquidity.status());
  80:         evidence.add("Funding/open interest: " + derivatives.status());
  81:         if (sentimentEnabled) {
  82:             evidence.add("Sentiment coverage: " + contributing + "/" + enabled + " enabled providers");
  83:         } else {
  84:             evidence.add("Sentiment is disabled and removed from the available maximum");
  85:         }
  86:         if (!valid) {
  87:             evidence.add("Required technical inputs are incomplete");
  88:         }
  89: 
  90:         return new MarketContextSnapshot(
  91:                 indicator.symbol(), indicator.intervalCode(), snapshotTime, valid,
  92:                 timeframe.status(), timeframe.higherInterval(), timeframe.higherTimeframeTrendScore(),
  93:                 btc.relationshipType(), btc.contextStatus(), btc.correlation(), btc.beta(),
  94:                 btc.influenceFactor(), btc.stable(), liquidity.status(), liquidity.imbalance(),
  95:                 liquidity.spreadPercent(), liquidity.observations(), derivatives.status(),
  96:                 derivatives.fundingRate(), derivatives.fundingPercentile(),
  97:                 derivatives.openInterestChangePercent(), derivatives.priceChangePercent(),
  98:                 derivatives.confidenceAdjustment(), sentimentEnabled,
  99:                 enabled, contributing, coverage, List.copyOf(evidence));
 100:     }
 101: }

  55:         if (!properties.enabled()) return result(DerivativesPositioningStatus.NOT_APPLICABLE, decision, entryAllowed,
  56:                 null, null, null, null, null, null, 0, period(interval), 0,

  85:                 allowed = false;

 108:     private DerivativesPositioningStatus classify(BigDecimal funding, BigDecimal oiChange, BigDecimal priceChange) {
 109:         if (funding != null && funding.compareTo(properties.extremeFundingRate()) >= 0) return DerivativesPositioningStatus.LONGS_CROWDED;
 110:         if (funding != null && funding.compareTo(properties.extremeFundingRate().negate()) <= 0) return DerivativesPositioningStatus.SHORTS_CROWDED;
 111:         if (oiChange == null || priceChange == null) return DerivativesPositioningStatus.BALANCED;
 112:         boolean oiRising = oiChange.compareTo(properties.openInterestChangeThreshold()) >= 0;
 113:         boolean oiFalling = oiChange.compareTo(properties.openInterestChangeThreshold().negate()) <= 0;
 114:         if (priceChange.signum() > 0 && oiRising) return DerivativesPositioningStatus.FRESH_LONG_BUILDUP;
 115:         if (priceChange.signum() < 0 && oiRising) return DerivativesPositioningStatus.FRESH_SHORT_BUILDUP;
 116:         if (priceChange.signum() > 0 && oiFalling) return DerivativesPositioningStatus.SHORT_COVERING;
 117:         if (priceChange.signum() < 0 && oiFalling) return DerivativesPositioningStatus.LONG_LIQUIDATION;
 118:         if (funding != null && funding.compareTo(properties.moderateFundingRate()) >= 0) return DerivativesPositioningStatus.HEALTHY_BULLISH;
 119:         if (funding != null && funding.compareTo(properties.moderateFundingRate().negate()) <= 0) return DerivativesPositioningStatus.HEALTHY_BEARISH;
 120:         return oiChange.abs().compareTo(properties.openInterestChangeThreshold()) < 0
 121:                 ? DerivativesPositioningStatus.LOW_CONVICTION : DerivativesPositioningStatus.BALANCED;
 122:     }
 123: 
 124:     private int confidence(DerivativesPositioningStatus status) {
 125:         return switch (status) {
 126:             case FRESH_LONG_BUILDUP, FRESH_SHORT_BUILDUP -> 8;
 127:             case HEALTHY_BULLISH, HEALTHY_BEARISH, BALANCED -> 3;
 128:             case SHORT_COVERING, LONG_LIQUIDATION, LOW_CONVICTION -> -5;
 129:             case LONGS_CROWDED, SHORTS_CROWDED -> -15;
 130:             case LEARNING -> -5;
 131:             case UNAVAILABLE -> -10;
 132:             case NOT_APPLICABLE -> 0;
 133:         };
 134:     }

**Scope owner:** Codex implementation / Claude independent review

## 1. Business objective

Make manual Replay reproduce the current paper-trading Production business flow
as closely as durable historical evidence permits, while remaining completely
isolated from Production trading state and wallet data.

The exact intended flow is:

```text
historical candle + historical context + canonical accepted price events
  -> shared Production indicator/signal/decision policies
  -> replay-local virtual wallet/account state
  -> shared sizing/allocation/entry revalidation policies
  -> replay-local position lifecycle
  -> shared TP/SL/profit-lock/continuation/exit policies
  -> replay output + explicit parity certificate
```

Replay must never write `wallet_*`, `paper_position`, `trade_signal`,
`signal_processing_work`, or any other Production trading table.

The result is not a claim that historical Java scheduling, MySQL lock timing,
network delay, external Binance availability, or the historical Production
wallet balance can be reproduced. It is a verified **business-logic parity**
claim only when all required market/decision evidence exists. Otherwise Replay
remains available as a labelled simulation and may not claim parity.

## 2. Confirmed root cause and evidence

The 2026-10-10 source audit established the following:

1. Signal, entry, normal-exit, continuation, profit-lock, and near-TP policy
   use several shared Production services.
2. `ShadowProductionReplayService` separately owns replay wallet cash,
   positions, daily budget, persistence, price-loop lifecycle, and result
   labels. It starts at `INITIAL_CAPITAL=10000`, runs one symbol/position, and
   does not reproduce Production wallet/global controls.
3. A run is labelled `EXACT_PRICE_REPLAY` when at least one accepted price
   event exists, rather than proving coverage for every interval while a
   position was open.
4. Historical derivatives information is not persisted;
   `DerivativesPositioningService.evaluateHistorical()` returns UNAVAILABLE.
   Historical order-book evaluation can likewise be unavailable when snapshots
   were not retained.
5. Replay-only FIX-11K and FIX-11Q observers, and the pre-FIX-122 UI revision,
   have no current Production equivalent and must not contaminate parity runs.
6. Current Replay reads `WalletSettingsRepository` directly and its near-TP
   path can call `BinanceMinimumExecutionPolicy`, which can request a current
   live Binance minimum notional. Both violate replay account/external-input
   isolation.

## 3. Boundaries

### In scope

- Replay input/evidence qualification and run-level parity status.
- Replay-local virtual wallet state, wallet controls, positions, executions,
  daily statistics, and global limit reproduction.
- Canonical price-event coverage qualification and event ordering.
- Historical context-evidence qualification for derivatives and order book.
- Removal of approved retired Replay-only business/experiment behaviour.
- Parity certificate, diagnostics, migrations, tests, documentation.

### Out of scope

- Any Production strategy change, sizing change, exit change, or wallet change.
- Live-exchange orders, fills, fees, slippage, or order-book execution modelling.
- Replaying database locks, thread scheduling, JVM pauses, WebSocket transport,
  external REST failures, or transaction retries as historical facts.
- FIX-153, FIX-154, and FIX-155 trading-policy changes.
- Deleting Production evidence or existing historical Replay/archive rows.

Each fixture holds: symbol, position identifier, recorded entry time, execution price and the observed-at time of that price, the entry signal identifier, the normalised fixed-notional basis (the recorded quantity is kept for audit and is not used for sizing), initial stop loss and take profit, entry scores, entry-consumption state, and the protection state at entry. The dataset has a content hash recorded in the run certificate. Replay reads the fixture file or Replay-owned fixture table only; the forbidden-dependency guard still applies to every account table. The extraction queries and their results are kept as evidence (E09).

agent-docs\FINAL_CHANGE_SPECIFICATION_RPR-0.9.1.md:226:The FIX-156 outcome target is **at least 99% agreement among qualified, comparable decisions, measured separately for signal parity and for lifecycle parity (Section 7.1); the two are never pooled**. A unit is one Production-recorded signal decision or position outcome. It passes only when the versioned comparison agrees on entry versus no entry, exit versus hold, exit reason, exit timestamp, and exit price within the frozen tolerance. Wallet-driven cases, insufficient-evidence cases and refused cases are excluded from the denominator and reported separately; none may be counted as a match. Every disagreement has a one-line classified cause. Average P&L is not a substitute for this decision-level metric.
agent-docs\FINAL_CHANGE_SPECIFICATION_RPR-0.9.1.md:228:**Validity conditions (frozen before the first measured run):** (a) a minimum coverage, meaning comparable cases as a share of all Production decisions in the window, reported next to the agreement rate; (b) a minimum number of comparable cases; (c) a lower confidence bound on the agreement rate, and the 99% target is judged on that bound, not the raw percentage; (d) the numeric values are set by the team from E06 evidence and approved by the owner. A result that fails (a) or (b) is reported as **not evaluable**, never as a pass.

Each fixture holds: symbol, position identifier, recorded entry time, execution price and the observed-at time of that price, the entry signal identifier, the normalised fixed-notional basis (the recorded quantity is kept for audit and is not used for sizing), initial stop loss and take profit, entry scores, entry-consumption state, and the protection state at entry. The dataset has a content hash recorded in the run certificate. Replay reads the fixture file or Replay-owned fixture table only; the forbidden-dependency guard still applies to every account table. The extraction queries and their results are kept as evidence (E09).

agent-docs\runs\20261011-224337\round02-codex.stderr.txt:262:The FIX-156 outcome target is **at least 99% agreement among qualified, comparable decisions, measured separately for signal parity and for lifecycle parity (Section 7.1); the two are never pooled**. A unit is one Production-recorded signal decision or position outcome. It passes only when the versioned comparison agrees on entry versus no entry, exit versus hold, exit reason, exit timestamp, and exit price within the frozen tolerance. Wallet-driven cases, insufficient-evidence cases and refused cases are excluded from the denominator and reported separately; none may be counted as a match. Every disagreement has a one-line classified cause. Average P&L is not a substitute for this decision-level metric.
agent-docs\runs\20261011-224337\round02-codex.stderr.txt:264:**Validity conditions (frozen before the first measured run):** (a) a minimum coverage, meaning comparable cases as a share of all Production decisions in the window, reported next to the agreement rate; (b) a minimum number of comparable cases; (c) a lower confidence bound on the agreement rate, and the 99% target is judged on that bound, not the raw percentage; (d) the numeric values are set by the team from E06 evidence and approved by the owner. A result that fails (a) or (b) is reported as **not evaluable**, never as a pass.

The dataset has a content hash recorded in the run certificate. Replay reads the fixture file or Replay-owned fixture table only; the forbidden-dependency guard still applies to every account table. The extraction queries and their results are kept as evidence (E09).

agent-docs\runs\20261011-224337\round02-codex.stderr.txt:1422:The FIX-156 outcome target is **at least 99% agreement among qualified, comparable decisions, measured separately for signal parity and for lifecycle parity (Section 7.1); the two are never pooled**. A unit is one Production-recorded signal decision or position outcome. It passes only when the versioned comparison agrees on entry versus no entry, exit versus hold, exit reason, exit timestamp, and exit price within the frozen tolerance. Wallet-driven cases, insufficient-evidence cases and refused cases are excluded from the denominator and reported separately; none may be counted as a match. Every disagreement has a one-line classified cause. Average P&L is not a substitute for this decision-level metric.
agent-docs\runs\20261011-224337\round02-codex.stderr.txt:1424:**Validity conditions (frozen before the first measured run):** (a) a minimum coverage, meaning comparable cases as a share of all Production decisions in the window, reported next to the agreement rate; (b) a minimum number of comparable cases; (c) a lower confidence bound on the agreement rate, and the 99% target is judged on that bound, not the raw percentage; (d) the numeric values are set by the team from E06 evidence and approved by the owner. A result that fails (a) or (b) is reported as **not evaluable**, never as a pass.

agent-docs\runs\20261011-224337\round02-codex.stderr.txt:2857:The FIX-156 outcome target is **at least 99% agreement among qualified, comparable decisions, measured separately for signal parity and for lifecycle parity (Section 7.1); the two are never pooled**. agent-docs\runs\20261011-230204\round02-codex.stderr.txt:72:**Recorded-entry fixtures (review finding F1).** A lifecycle comparison is seeded from Production's recorded entries, which live in the account tables that Replay may not read. The recorded entries therefore reach Replay only as an **immutable entry-fixture dataset**, prepared by a separate read-only extraction that runs outside the Replay execution boundary and is never part of a Replay run. Each fixture holds: symbol, position identifier, recorded entry time, execution price and the observed-at time of that price, the entry signal identifier, the normalised fixed-notional basis (the recorded quantity is kept for audit and is not used for sizing), initial stop loss and take profit, entry scores, entry-consumption state, and the protection state at entry. The dataset has a content hash recorded in the run certificate. Replay reads the fixture file or Replay-owned fixture table only; the forbidden-dependency guard still applies to every account table. The extraction queries and their results are kept as evidence (E09).

agent-docs\runs\20261011-230204\round02-codex.stderr.txt:4168:36:**Recorded-entry fixtures (review finding F1).** A lifecycle comparison is seeded from Production's recorded entries, which live in the account tables that Replay may not read. The recorded entries therefore reach Replay only as an **immutable entry-fixture dataset**, prepared by a separate read-only extraction that runs outside the Replay execution boundary and is never part of a Replay run. Each fixture holds: symbol, position identifier, recorded entry time, execution price and the observed-at time of that price, the entry signal identifier, the normalised fixed-notional basis (the recorded quantity is kept for audit and is not used for sizing), initial stop loss and take profit, entry scores, entry-consumption state, and the protection state at entry. The dataset has a content hash recorded in the run certificate. Replay reads the fixture file or Replay-owned fixture table only; the forbidden-dependency guard still applies to every account table. The extraction queries and their results are kept as evidence (E09).

agent-docs\runs\20261011-230204\round02-codex.stderr.txt:4358:226:The FIX-156 outcome target is **at least 99% agreement among qualified, comparable decisions, measured separately for signal parity and for lifecycle parity (Section 7.1); the two are never pooled**. A unit is one Production-recorded signal decision or position outcome. It passes only when the versioned comparison agrees on entry versus no entry, exit versus hold, exit reason, exit timestamp, and exit price within the frozen tolerance. Wallet-driven cases, insufficient-evidence cases and refused cases are excluded from the denominator and reported separately; none may be counted as a match. Every disagreement has a one-line classified cause. Average P&L is not a substitute for this decision-level metric.

A result that fails (a) or (b) is reported as **not evaluable**, never as a pass.

The extraction queries and their results are kept as evidence (E09).

agent-docs\runs\20261011-230204\round02-codex.prompt.txt:250:The FIX-156 outcome target is **at least 99% agreement among qualified, comparable decisions, measured separately for signal parity and for lifecycle parity (Section 7.1); the two are never pooled**. agent-docs\runs\20261011-224337\round02-claude.prompt.txt:60:**Recorded-entry fixtures (review finding F1).** A lifecycle comparison is seeded from Production's recorded entries, which live in the account tables that Replay may not read. The dataset has a content hash recorded in the run certificate. Replay reads the fixture file or Replay-owned fixture table only; the forbidden-dependency guard still applies to every account table. The extraction queries and their results are kept as evidence (E09).

agent-docs\runs\20261011-224337\round02-claude.prompt.txt:250:The FIX-156 outcome target is **at least 99% agreement among qualified, comparable decisions, measured separately for signal parity and for lifecycle parity (Section 7.1); the two are never pooled**. A unit is one Production-recorded signal decision or position outcome. It passes only when the versioned comparison agrees on entry versus no entry, exit versus hold, exit reason, exit timestamp, and exit price within the frozen tolerance. Wallet-driven cases, insufficient-evidence cases and refused cases are excluded from the denominator and reported separately; none may be counted as a match. Every disagreement has a one-line classified cause. Average P&L is not a substitute for this decision-level metric.
agent-docs\runs\20261011-224337\round02-claude.prompt.txt:252:**Validity conditions (frozen before the first measured run):** (a) a minimum coverage, meaning comparable cases as a share of all Production decisions in the window, reported next to the agreement rate; (b) a minimum number of comparable cases; (c) a lower confidence bound on the agreement rate, and the 99% target is judged on that bound, not the raw percentage; (d) the numeric values are set by the team from E06 evidence and approved by the owner. A result that fails (a) or (b) is reported as **not evaluable**, never as a pass.

The extraction queries and their results are kept as evidence (E09).

agent-docs\runs\20261011-230204\round02-claude.prompt.txt:250:The FIX-156 outcome target is **at least 99% agreement among qualified, comparable decisions, measured separately for signal parity and for lifecycle parity (Section 7.1); the two are never pooled**. A unit is one Production-recorded signal decision or position outcome. Every disagreement has a one-line classified cause. Average P&L is not a substitute for this decision-level metric.
